fields.Name: Artifact Block Frozen
fields.Description: Logged when a live data block inside a Document or Presentation is frozen to a static snapshot.

fields.Name: Artifact Connected Drive Sync
fields.Description: Logged when an artifact version is pushed to or pulled from a linked external Connected Drive (OneDrive, SharePoint, or Google Drive).

fields.Name: Artifact Exported
fields.Description: Logged when a governed artifact is exported to DOCX, PPTX, XLSX, PDF, Markdown, or HTML.

fields.Name: Artifact Permission Changed
fields.Description: Logged when Read/Edit/Delete/Share access on a governed artifact or collection is granted or updated.

fields.Name: Artifact Guest Share Link
fields.Description: Logged when an external Frozen-only guest share link is created or revoked.
